ui_scenarios.name: Release wrapper validation matrix, tool manifest, and docs stay synced
Exported desktop pack artifact is generated and reviewed from the local build verifier
ui_scenarios.reason: The shell verifier creates and boots the pack automatically, but human QA still needs to inspect the artifact location and release handoff language.

ui_scenarios.name: Desktop binary export path communicates missing export templates or creates a runnable app
ui_scenarios.reason: Local binary export depends on installed Godot export templates and macOS signing state, which are machine-specific release-environment checks.

ui_scenarios.name: Release build start, save, quit, relaunch, and continue loop is reviewed outside the editor
ui_scenarios.reason: The current automated pack smoke proves bootability; the full relaunch-and-continue feel check still needs a human-run desktop build once templates/signing are available.
